messages:
alex: Heads up — billing alert: ~3x GPU instance spend spike in the last hour. Looks like autoscaler launched a bunch of high-end GPUs in us-east1.
alex: I have the billing snapshot here: https://billing.example.com/snaps/1767777777 (redacted)
billing-bot: [alert] unexpected-cost-spike project:redwood-inference amount:$48,200 period:1h tags:autoscale,us-east1
maria: yikes. any idea which instance type? a100/p4d? or just a capacity/region mismatch?
alex: quick grep from the instance list shows many nodes with accelerator: nvidia-a100-40gb and instance-template tag "late-binding". Expected pool should be g4dn or t4 for this workload. Copying output:
```
NAME                   ZONE        MACHINE_TYPE          ACCELERATOR
redwood-gpu-joe-3      us-east1-b  n1-highmem-32         nvidia-a100-40gb
redwood-gpu-joe-4      us-east1-c  n1-highmem-32         nvidia-a100-40gb
```
jordan: hmm autoscaler may have fallen back to late-binding node templates after the us-west capacity pool hit its quota. Late-binding config doesn't pin instanceType/region strictly.
maria: that explains it — our reserved commitments are for a100 in us-west1 committed-use discounts, but these launched in us-east1 so they're on-demand full price.
selina-finance: can you post the quick cost delta? how much of that $48k is the cross-region penalty vs normal usage?
alex: pasted a tiny CSV excerpt:
```
region,sku,cost
us-west1,a100-reserved,    $4,200 (hourly apportion)
us-east1,a100-on-demand,   $44,000
```
alex: rough numbers; i'll hand off precise billing reports to finance but this explains the majority of the spike.
jordan: immediate mitigation: set autoscaler max to current size to stop further launches, and scale down any non-critical pools. I'll run the runbook.
ops-bot: Executing: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize redwood-gpu-pool --size 12 --region us-east1` (user:jordan)
ops-bot: Draining new nodes: `kubectl drain ...` (started)
maria: i'm opening a config patch to enforce instanceType + region whitelist in the autoscaler policy. also adding a hard cap on fallback to on-demand zones.
alex: filed infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7892 — notes: autoscaler late-binding allowed cross-region a100 launches, recommend locking template, adding quota alerts.
selina-finance: will pull final invoice line items and reconcile tomorrow. please tag me when you've reduced spend.
maria: PR #2345 created to add region/instance whitelist + fail-open=false. Testing in staging now.
jordan: once staging green i'll cut a hotfix to production. Also will add alert if autoscaler uses instanceTypes not listed in reserved commitments.
alex: thanks. follow-up: create a runbook entry for reserved commitments vs autoscaler fallbacks.
maria: PR merged to main at 1767781200. Hotfix queued. We'll monitor cost delta over the next 24h.
selina-finance: thanks everyone — looping in legal for contract impact if needed. :thumbsup:
alex: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see further anomalies"
